appDescription: An in-car takeout ordering app that times food preparation to the car's live navigation ETA, so the order is ready the moment the driver arrives at the store.

function.name: ORDER_USUAL
function.description: Place the user's saved favorite takeout order at a store along the current route. Use when the user says things like 'order my usual' or 'the usual chicken on the way home'.

favoriteName.description: Name or food category of the saved favorite order the user mentioned, such as 'chicken' or 'pizza'. Empty if the user just said 'my usual'.

function.name: FIND_PICKUP_STORE
function.description: Find takeout stores of the requested food category on or near the current navigation route and show them so the user can choose when the car is stopped.

category.description: Food category the user wants to pick up.

function.name: CANCEL_PICKUP_ORDER
function.description: Cancel the user's current takeout order if the store has not started cooking yet.
